Price is exposed twice: raw unformatted number via itemprop='Price' (e.g. '16.95', no currency symbol — easiest to parse) and a formatted '16,95 €' string in a plain

with no stable class. Stock text seen: 'Heti saatavilla' (in stock) and 'Vain Jyväskylän myymälässä' (store-pickup-only variant) — both in an unstyled

, no reliable stock class/attribute found, so in_stock left null.
